test.subject: Test email
test.body: This is a test email for {name}.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to confirm your email address. It works once and lasts 24 hours:
{link}

If you did not sign up, ignore this email.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirm.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to make this your new email address. It works once and lasts 24 hours:
{link}

Until then your old address stays in use. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

email_changed_notice.subject: Your email address was changed
email_changed_notice.body:
Hello {name},

The email address on your account was changed. From now on you sign in with the new address.

If this was not you, contact your department admin.

already_registered.subject: You already have an account

reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password. It works once and lasts 1 hour:
{link}

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed

failed_logins.subject: Many failed sign-in attempts on your account

second_step_code.subject: Your sign-in code
second_step_code.body:
Hello {name},

Your sign-in code is {code}. It works once and lasts 10 minutes. If you did not try to sign in, change your password.
